case_name: The flower shop ad: the key-reference pipeline (runs/keyref-1) against the MCP
title: Petal & Stem, a 16 s flower shop ad

turns.text: A 16-second widescreen ad for Petal & Stem, a small neighbourhood flower shop: the florist opens the shop at dawn and arranges a bouquet, then hands it to a smiling customer at the door; warm, natural light; end on the shop front.

tests: The same brief the key-reference pipeline ran (runs/keyref-1, two clips joined by the last frame): story beats in order, the same florist, customer and bouquet across the piece, the shop's name spelled right on the front at the end.
must_haves: The florist opens the shop at dawn, arranges a bouquet, and hands it to a smiling customer at the door, in that order.
The florist, the customer and the bouquet stay the same throughout; no extra or floating bouquets.
It ends on the shop front, with the name reading exactly "Petal & Stem" if a sign is shown.
